title: Runtime timing samples
responsibility: Times complete runtime invocations and summarizes warmed samples or repeated rounds into latency and throughput measurements.

inputs.name: benchSamples.runtime
inputs.description: An initialized runtime with an invoke method and a kind used in failure messages. The benchmark calls invoke three times for warm-up and then once per iterations loop pass; it does not initialize or close the runtime.

inputs.name: benchSamples.request
inputs.description: The RuntimeRequest passed unchanged to each warm-up and measured invocation. This helper does not inspect or validate its operation or input.

inputs.name: benchSamples.iterations
inputs.description: The loop bound for measured calls after three warm-up calls; it is not validated. Nonpositive values produce no measured samples, while positive fractional values can execute a rounded-up number of calls.

inputs.name: median.values
inputs.description: Numeric samples whose copied array is sorted before selecting the middle value or middle-pair average. An empty array returns NaN, and the input array is not mutated.

inputs.name: timeCall.runtime
inputs.description: An initialized runtime with invoke and kind properties. The elapsed time covers awaiting invoke; a response with ok false is rejected as an Error.

inputs.name: timeCall.request
inputs.description: The RuntimeRequest passed unchanged to one runtime invocation. Its operation and optional input are not inspected by this helper.

inputs.name: benchRounds.runtime
inputs.description: An initialized runtime used for warmupCalls warm-up invocations and every measured invocation. The helper does not initialize or close it.

inputs.name: benchRounds.request
inputs.description: The RuntimeRequest passed unchanged to each warm-up and measured invocation. Its operation and optional input are not inspected by this helper.

inputs.name: benchRounds.shape
inputs.description: The rounds and iterations loop bounds used for measured samples after warmupCalls warm-up calls. Neither value is validated; nonpositive values skip the corresponding loop, and fractional values can execute a rounded-up number of passes.

inputs.name: roundMeasurements.result
inputs.description: A RoundResult whose floorMs, warmMs, and opsPerSecond become the three measurement values. The samples field is not read by this function.

inputs.name: roundMeasurements.where
inputs.description: The boundary description interpolated into each measurement method string. The helper appends a fixed note about request validation, serialization, and response parsing.

outputs.name: median
outputs.description: The middle value of a sorted copy for odd-length input, or the average of the two middle values for even-length input. Empty input returns NaN.

outputs.name: timeCall
outputs.description: Resolved elapsed milliseconds from performance.now() around one successful awaited runtime.invoke call. A response with ok false rejects with an Error instead of returning a duration.

outputs.name: benchSamples
outputs.description: A WarmResult with median measured-call latency, throughput computed as iterations times 1000 divided by the sum of measured durations, and the requested iterations value. Three warm-up calls always run; iterations is not validated, so an empty measurement set can yield NaN fields.

outputs.name: benchRounds
outputs.description: A RoundResult with the fastest single measured call, the median of round medians, throughput computed as 1000 divided by that median, and samples set to rounds times iterations. Counts are not validated, so empty or zero-duration measurements can yield non-finite results.

outputs.name: roundMeasurements
outputs.type: { metric: string; unitOfMeasure: string; value: number; method: string; }[]
outputs.description: Three records in latency-floor-ms, latency-warm-ms, then throughput-ops order. Each record contains metric, unitOfMeasure, value, and a method string describing the timing boundary.

examples.method: Fastest of runtime.invoke, including request validation, serialization and response parsing.
Median of the round medians over runtime.invoke, including request validation, serialization and response parsing.
Calls per second at the median over runtime.invoke, including request validation, serialization and response parsing.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: timeCall throws an Error when invoke resolves with ok false, using the runtime kind and response error message; benchSamples and benchRounds propagate that failure. Any rejection from invoke also propagates unchanged.
